result.note: Tested the critical mineral auction totals, first-time states and the Exploration Licence count in one statements question.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the auction of critical and strategic mineral blocks by the Ministry of Mines, as of June 2026:
items: Under the Seventh Tranche, blocks were put up for auction for the first time in Gujarat, Uttarakhand and Telangana.
A total of 56 blocks had been auctioned out of the 88 blocks offered by the Centre since the programme began.
After the Second Tranche of Exploration Licence auctions, the cumulative number of Exploration Licences stood at 56.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the Second Tranche lifted the cumulative Exploration Licence total to 11. The figure of 56 refers to mineral blocks auctioned, a 63% clearance rate across 88 blocks offered. These minerals feed clean energy, electric mobility, electronics and defence manufacturing under the National Critical Mineral Mission.
questions.source: The Ministry also closed its Second Tranche of Exploration Licence (EL) auctions, lifting the cumulative EL total to 11 and extending the framework to Arunachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Odisha.
